newsitem.title: USA: South Jersey sub licensed to trade power.
newsitem.headline: South Jersey sub licensed to trade power.

text.p: South Jersey Industries Inc said subsidiary South Jersey Energy Co has been certified by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to trade electricity on a nationwide basis.

Although the FERC certification allows the company to trade power throughout the U.S., South Jersey Energy will focus its initial marketing efforts in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions, the company said.

The approval of the license to market electricity gives South Jersey Energy the ability to take advantage of opportunities resulting from the deregulation of the electricity industry, the company said.
